<h2>Summarise Spatial MEM Benchmark Predictions</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Converts paired exact or fast out-of-fold predictions into one benchmark
row per repetition using the shared fold-local evaluation definitions.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>summarise_spatial_mev_benchmark_predictions(
  data_predictions = NULL,
  spatial_mev_strategy = NULL,
  technical_cv_status = "pass",
  assignment_hash = NULL,
  artifact_schema_hash = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_predictions">data_predictions</code></td>
<td>
<p>Long out-of-fold prediction table accepted by
[evaluate_sjsdm_fold_predictions()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="spatial_mev_strategy">spatial_mev_strategy</code></td>
<td>
<p>Spatial MEM strategy used to produce the predictions.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="technical_cv_status">technical_cv_status</code></td>
<td>
<p>Technical status recorded for the benchmark run.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="assignment_hash">assignment_hash</code>, <code id="artifact_schema_hash">artifact_schema_hash</code></td>
<td>
<p>Stable identifiers used to verify paired technical equivalence.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Tibble with one row per repetition and spatial MEM strategy.
</p>

</main>
